generic.Defined scope/population: Annuity applications flagged in good order and awaiting routing to suitability in the workflow case management tool
generic.In-scope period: Cases reaching good-order status during the current processing day
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Good-order flag, producer of record, state of solicitation and product code populated before routing
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of cases routed to suitability equals the count that reached good order that day
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Routing event stored on the case with routing user, target queue and timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cases that fail routing or land in the wrong queue logged with reason and reroute date
generic.Test population: All suitability-queue routing events raised on the sampled processing day
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every routed case carries a good-order flag set before its routing event
generic.Exception handling path: Misrouted cases are returned to the case manager and rerouted within one business day
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case resides in the suitability queue with routing user, timestamp and turnaround clock started
generic.Evidence location: Case history in the workflow case management tool

steps.title: Open the good-order case in the workflow case management tool
sop: Select the application case from the ready-to-route work queue
Confirm the good-order flag reads GO and no deficiency line is open
Done when the case is open and its good-order flag is confirmed
verify: Re-read the case header status field
Pass when the case status shows In Good Order with no open deficiency lines

steps.title: Verify suitability questionnaire images are attached in the case
sop: Open the imaged document set attached to the case
Check every suitability questionnaire page is present and legible
Done when all questionnaire pages are confirmed attached and readable
verify: Count questionnaire pages against the form page count
Pass when the attached page count equals the form page count and all pages are legible

steps.title: Confirm producer and solicitation state on the policy administration system record
sop: Open the contract record and read the producer of record and state of solicitation
Compare both to the signed application image
Done when producer and solicitation state match the application
verify: Re-read both fields on the contract record
Pass when producer and state of solicitation are populated and agree with the application

steps.title: Select the suitability review queue as the routing target in the workflow tool
sop: Choose the suitability review queue from the routing target list
Confirm the issue queue has not been selected by default
Done when the suitability review queue is selected as the target
verify: Read the selected target queue before committing the route
Pass when the target queue reads Suitability Review and not Issue

steps.title: Commit the routing action and stamp the routing date on the case
sop: Commit the routing action so the case leaves the intake queue
Confirm the system stamps the routing date that starts the suitability clock
Done when the case is assigned to the suitability queue with a routing date
verify: Open the case history and read the newest routing event
Pass when a routing event to Suitability Review exists with user and timestamp

steps.title: Confirm queue assignment and clear the case from the intake work list
sop: Refresh the suitability queue and confirm the case appears in it
Confirm the case no longer appears in the intake work list
Done when the case is visible only in the suitability queue
verify: Search both queues for the case number
Pass when the case is found in the suitability queue and absent from the intake queue

generic.Defined scope/population: Annuity contracts awaiting a rate lock or interest crediting start date in the policy administration system
generic.In-scope period: Applications with funds applied or rate locks expiring in the current processing week
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Rate sheet version, lock start date, lock expiry date and crediting start date all populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of contracts with a locked rate equals the count of applications in the lock population
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rate sheet version and lock dates stored on the contract with the setting user and timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Re-locks and lock extensions logged with the approver and the approval note
generic.Test population: Contracts with a rate lock applied during the sampled week
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every locked contract shows a lock effective date, expiry date and rate sheet reference
generic.Exception handling path: Contracts outside the lock window are re-rated and the new rate is confirmed to the producer
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Locked rate written to the contract record and reproduced on the owner confirmation
generic.Evidence location: Contract rate record in the policy administration system

steps.title: Retrieve the application signature and receipt dates from the policy administration system
sop: Open the contract record and read the application signature date and intake receipt date
Confirm both dates agree with the imaged application and the intake stamp
Done when both dates are confirmed from source
verify: Compare the recorded dates to the application image
Pass when signature and receipt dates on the record match the source documents

steps.title: Select the rate sheet version effective on the application signature date
sop: Open the product rate sheet library and locate the version effective on the signature date
Confirm the sheet covers the product, share class and premium band applied for
Done when the correct rate sheet version is selected
verify: Read the effective and superseded dates of the selected rate sheet
Pass when the signature date falls inside the selected sheet's effective range

steps.title: Calculate the rate lock expiry date from the receipt date in the workflow tool
sop: Apply the product's lock window length to the intake receipt date
Record the resulting expiry date on the case
Done when the lock expiry date is calculated and recorded
verify: Recompute the expiry date from receipt date plus the product lock window
Pass when the recorded expiry date equals the recomputed date

steps.title: Set the interest crediting start date to the good-funds date on the contract
sop: Read the date the premium was confirmed collected and applied
Key that date as the interest crediting start date rather than the application date
Done when the crediting start date equals the good-funds date
verify: Compare the crediting start date to the premium application transaction date
Pass when the crediting start date equals the date good funds were applied

steps.title: Write the locked rate and dates to the contract record
sop: Key the locked rate, rate sheet reference, lock start and lock expiry to the contract
Save and confirm the values persist on the contract rate panel
Done when the locked rate and all lock dates are stored on the contract
verify: Re-open the contract rate panel after saving
Pass when locked rate, rate sheet version and both lock dates are populated

steps.title: Document any re-lock or lock extension approval on the case
sop: Where the lock was extended or reset, record the reason and the approving manager
Attach the approval note to the case in the workflow tool
Done when every re-lock or extension carries a documented approval
verify: List all lock changes on the contract and match each to an approval note
Pass when no lock change exists without a recorded approver and reason

steps.title: Confirm the locked rate appears on the owner confirmation output
sop: Preview the contract confirmation document generated from the record
Check the locked rate and crediting start date print correctly
Done when the confirmation shows the locked rate and crediting start date
verify: Compare the printed rate to the contract rate panel
Pass when the confirmation rate equals the rate stored on the contract

generic.Defined scope/population: New annuity applications requiring customer identification programme verification under BSA
generic.In-scope period: Applications received and pending CIP clearance in the current processing week
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Legal name, date of birth, residential address and TIN or SSN present and matching the application
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of CIP records equals the count of applications pending identification clearance
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: ID image and CIP verification result filed in the document repository with capture date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Expired, missing or mismatched identification logged as an exception with its cure date
generic.Test population: Applications cleared for CIP during the sampled week
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every cleared application holds an unexpired ID image and a recorded verification method
generic.Exception handling path: Cases failing CIP are pended and escalated to compliance before funds are applied
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: CIP result, method and reviewer recorded against the application before issue
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository indexed to the application number

steps.title: Retrieve the identification documents from the document management repository
sop: Open the application folder and locate the government-issued photo identification image
Confirm the image is legible and shows the full document face
Done when the identification image is retrieved and readable
verify: Inspect the image for cropping or illegible fields
Pass when name, date of birth and expiry date are all readable on the image

steps.title: Check the identification expiry date against the application date
sop: Read the expiry date printed on the identification document
Compare it to the application signature date
Done when the identification is confirmed unexpired at the application date
verify: Re-read the expiry date and the application date together
Pass when the expiry date is later than the application signature date

steps.title: Match name, date of birth, address and TIN to the policy administration system record
sop: Open the owner record and compare each identity field to the identification document
Note any mismatch as a deficiency rather than correcting silently
Done when all four identity fields are compared and results noted
verify: List any field where document and record differ
Pass when no identity field mismatch remains unresolved

steps.title: Confirm the correct tax certification form for the owner type
sop: Determine whether the owner is a US person or a non-resident alien
Confirm a signed Form W-9 or Form W-8BEN is on file as appropriate
Done when the correct signed tax certification form is confirmed present
verify: Open the filed certification form and read the signature and date
Pass when the form type matches the owner status and carries a signature and date

steps.title: Obtain beneficial ownership certification for entity-owned contracts
sop: Where the owner is an entity, locate the beneficial ownership certification
Confirm every beneficial owner at 25 percent or more is named and identified
Done when beneficial ownership certification is complete for entity owners
verify: Compare the certified ownership percentages to the 25 percent threshold
Pass when every owner at or above the threshold is named with identifying data

steps.title: Record the CIP verification result and method on the contract record
sop: Key the verification outcome and the method used, documentary or non-documentary
Record the reviewer name and the verification date
Done when the CIP result, method and reviewer are stored on the case
verify: Re-open the CIP panel on the contract record
Pass when result, method, reviewer and date are all populated

steps.title: File the identification evidence set to the document repository
sop: Index the identification image, tax form and CIP record to the application number
Apply the retention class required for BSA records
Done when the full identification evidence set is indexed and retained
verify: Search the repository by application number
Pass when the identification image and CIP record are both retrievable

generic.Defined scope/population: Annuity applications under good-order review in the workflow case management tool
generic.In-scope period: Applications received and reviewed during the current processing day
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Signatures, dates, premium amount, product code and share class all present on the application
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of good-order determinations equals the count of applications reviewed that day
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Good-order determination stored with the reviewer name and the determination timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Applications failing any good-order criterion logged as NIGO with a reason code
generic.Test population: Applications given a good-order determination in the sampled day
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No application is marked in good order while a mandatory requirement is unmet
generic.Exception handling path: Failed applications are set to NIGO and returned to the producer with itemised defects
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Status reads In Good Order with reviewer and determination date recorded
generic.Evidence location: Case record in the workflow case management tool

steps.title: Open the application case and its imaged forms in the workflow tool
sop: Select the case from the good-order review queue
Open the imaged application, disclosures and funding paperwork together
Done when the case and all imaged forms are open for review
verify: Confirm each expected form appears in the image set
Pass when application, disclosures and funding paperwork are all present

steps.title: Check signatures and dates for every required signer on the application
sop: Check the owner, joint owner, annuitant and producer signature blocks
Confirm each signature carries a date on or before the receipt date
Done when every required signature and date is confirmed present
verify: Re-inspect each signature block for a signature and a date
Pass when no required signature or signature date is missing

steps.title: Confirm state-specific replacement and disclosure forms for the solicitation state
sop: Read the state of solicitation from the application
Confirm each form the state requires is present at the correct edition
Done when all state-required forms are confirmed present and current
verify: Compare the filed form editions to the state requirement list
Pass when every state-required form is present at the current edition

steps.title: Agree the application premium to the funds or transfer paperwork
sop: Read the premium amount stated on the application
Compare it to the deposit advice or the transfer request amount
Done when the premium is agreed to the funding evidence
verify: Recompute the difference between application premium and funding amount
Pass when the difference is zero or an explained partial funding is documented

steps.title: Confirm the elected product and share class are open for new business
sop: Look up the product and share class in the policy administration system product table
Confirm both are open for new business on the application date
Done when the product and share class are confirmed open
verify: Read the product open and close dates in the product table
Pass when the application date falls inside the product availability window

steps.title: Record the good-order determination with the reviewer name
sop: Select the In Good Order disposition on the case
Confirm the reviewer name and determination timestamp are captured
Done when the good-order determination is recorded with the reviewer
verify: Re-read the case disposition panel
Pass when status equals In Good Order with reviewer and date recorded

steps.title: Release the case only after all good-order gates pass
sop: Confirm no open deficiency line remains on the case
Release the case to the next stage in the workflow tool
Done when the case is released with no open deficiencies
verify: List open deficiency lines on the released case
Pass when the released case has zero open deficiency lines

generic.Defined scope/population: Initial annuity premium remittances received by cheque, wire or ACH awaiting application
generic.In-scope period: Remittances received in the current banking day
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Application number, remitter, amount and receipt date populated on the deposit record
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Total premium applied equals the total deposit banked for the day
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Deposit advice and application posting retained with the receipt date and posting timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unmatched or third-party remittances logged in suspense with an investigation owner
generic.Test population: Initial premium receipts posted during the sampled banking day
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No initial premium remains unapplied in suspense beyond 48 hours
generic.Exception handling path: Unmatched funds are held in suspense and referred to the case manager for identification
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Premium posted to the matching application with a recorded collected-funds date
generic.Evidence location: Deposit and premium transaction records in the billing and commission platform

steps.title: Retrieve the day's remittance advices from the billing and commission platform
sop: Open the daily receipts list for annuity new business
Extract cheque, wire and ACH advices awaiting application
Done when the day's unapplied remittances are listed
verify: Compare the list count to the bank deposit summary count
Pass when the number of advices equals the number of banked items

steps.title: Match each remittance to an application number in the policy administration system
sop: Search by remitter name, application number and amount
Attach the matched application number to the remittance record
Done when every remittance is matched or flagged as unmatched
verify: Count matched and unmatched remittances
Pass when matched plus unmatched equals the total remittances retrieved

steps.title: Agree the deposit amount to the application premium
sop: Compare the banked amount to the premium stated on the application
Record any shortfall or overpayment as a difference on the case
Done when each deposit is agreed or a difference is recorded
verify: Recompute deposit less application premium for each item
Pass when every non-zero difference carries a recorded explanation

steps.title: Confirm funds are collected rather than merely presented
sop: Check the bank clearing status for each cheque and ACH item
Hold items still in the clearing period from application
Done when only collected funds are released for application
verify: Read the clearing status of each item to be applied
Pass when every item being applied shows collected status

steps.title: Apply the premium to the matching application in the policy administration system
sop: Post the collected premium against the matched application number
Avoid posting to a generic suspense account where a match exists
Done when the premium is posted to the matched application
verify: Open the application premium panel after posting
Pass when the application shows the premium applied with the correct amount

steps.title: Record the receipt date that drives the contract effective date
sop: Key the collected-funds date to the receipt date field on the application
Confirm the field is used downstream as the contract effective date driver
Done when the receipt date is recorded on the application
verify: Compare the recorded receipt date to the bank collected date
Pass when the receipt date equals the collected-funds date

steps.title: Flag unmatched or third-party remittances rather than force-applying them
sop: Leave unmatched items in suspense with an investigation note
Refer third-party remittances to the case manager for authorisation
Done when all unmatched items carry an investigation owner and note
verify: List items remaining in suspense with their age
Pass when no suspense item is older than 48 hours without an escalation note
